input: 팀 회의 녹음을 전사할 한국어 음성인식 모델을 자체 GPU 서버(16GB)에서 돌리려고 해. 외부 AI API는 못 쓰고, 나중에 상업화할 수 있게 라이선스 제약이 없어야 해.
outputs: The model is designed for automatic speech recognition (ASR) specifically for Korean language audio. It supports a wide range of audio formats and is optimized to run efficiently on GPU servers with 16GB of memory. With a parameter count of 100 million, it strikes a balance between performance and resource usage. The model is licensed under a permissive license, allowing for commercial use without restrictions. Intended use cases include transcribing team meetings, lectures, and interviews, making it ideal for businesses and educational institutions. Its strengths lie in its high accuracy and ability to handle various accents and speech patterns in Korean.
